guardrails: An activation is an offer to claim, never an automatic claim.
Generated activation requires fresh READY presence and a currently eligible dispatch packet.
Activation expiry is bounded by presence expiry, dispatch hard expiry, and activation TTL.
One worker receives at most one current activation.
One slot receives at most one current activation.
Manual overrides remain explicit and do not require activation.
Unknown or stale presence is not interpreted as worker failure.
